notes.title: Professionals Abroad DLC Available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30444167/028516ef57eef98c96aba4d648c11b56b3fac803.png[/img]

[h2]Take on Nowheraki Insurgents in 12 explosive missions. 
[/h2]
When Uncle Sam calls, Nowhere City SWAT answers! Deployed overseas to combat a new terrorist threat directly at the source, our heroes find themselves face to face with a deadly Insurgent network as well as the old familiar enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30444167/a7354175fc41e4a4c5d0bb7783e60ca62baf5602.png[/img]

In a special crossover event with Door Kickers 2 Task Force North, visit new exotic locations and meet new threats equipped with dependable AKs, old but deadly Armor Piercing Snipers rifles, suicide vests and even commandeered Attack Helicopters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30444167/66a132472fd40edbe689c39b89b625982a6873b3.png[/img]
The DLC includes 12 fresh and challenging missions that take Action Squad level design to the max and  go further than any content we've put out before. Jump out of helicopters, blow up walls and find new ways to navigate the environment - but think fast, time is of the essence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30444167/70a3da2f9de657d1242a0eb76d81865762511a5d.png[/img]

With that thought in mine, what are you waiting for? Get the DLC and liberate some Nowheraki for us. 

Your devs @ KHG and PixelShard

notes.title: Action Squad, Consoles, Next Week
notes.content:
The day you've been waiting for is coming. Next week, Action Squad releases on consoles - XBox One and PS4 on the [b]24th[/b], Nintendo Switch on the [b]28th[/b].

[previewyoutube=9tDfQ4SQrGI;full]https://youtu.be/9tDfQ4SQrGI[/previewyoutube]

The exact same experience you love on the PC translates to the new platforms, but there's also new content included, and it's coming [b]back to PC on the exact same day[/b]:
[list]

[*]  couple of new enemies
[*]  lots of goodies even for the old gang of troopers

Your Devs @ PixelShard & KillHouse Games

notes.title: Infinite Mode Added
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/ec78a244f1cbe7db202b22770f3082a09af45c7a.png[/img]

It's Christmas! It's a time for love and giving, so give them hell in the Newly inaugurated Infinity Tower. What goes on in there, anyway? Nobody knows! How tall is it? It's still mystery ...

The real question is [b]How [i]high[/i] can YOU go?[/b]

[b]Quick points:[/b]
- This is a one-way raid and there's no return. The only way is UP. 
- You're cutoff from supplies so enemy kills don't give Strategic Points. 
- Every five floors there should be a bunch of hostages to rescue. Higher up they become scarcer so spend those points wisely.
- We've also revamped the lighting system and its much more natural now.
- Door Kickers 2 is still in development.

Let us know how you liked this little surprise, and whether we should add more stuff to it, or maybe we should instead concentrate on more zombie stuff ... errr ... I mean handcrafted missions.  

Merry Christmas - and a Happy New Year!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/68f9cf56b4f5b57a17c2fe086f53e21b3fad600d.gif[/img]

Your devs @ KHG and PixelShard

notes.title: Halloween Surprise Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/e0c4712be131fbf6d079ab6fb43f7cf9f92cec9f.png[/img]

Gang, you know us... we're KillHouse Games. We're always dead serious (apart from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/248610/announcements/detail/168098067907812019]small innocent April's Fools jokes[/url]). Our first game is used by the military to train, right? We don't do .... zombies. 

But Action Squad is our crazy child, and we can't really control what it does. So this week, it stumbled into the Nowhere City cemetery, and this happened: 

https://youtu.be/wrRM3nkVnpY

So, what's in our treat bag this Halloween:
- 4 zombie style enemies added. Or were they 5? 6? Be careful, reports are still garbled. 
- Weekly challenge #3 is your special Halloween Level, and its a tough one. 
- or you can go in "Zombie Invasion Mode" and enjoy the entire game, all levels, with extra zombie sauce. Beware, results are completely unpredictable.
[i]- Or you can just ignore the whole thing, play the zombie-free Classic Mode and shake your fist at the screen for lack of a proper "ultra realistic Week 3 Challenge". 
[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/7396f1d35db8bb16a2a261d8dcc1491d8ee4ec11.gif[/img]

There's Dark Portals spawning around the world, you need to get there and close them down. Stop reading, start playing.

Let us know how you liked this little surprise, and whether we should add more stuff to it, or maybe it should be thrown into the pit and set on fire. Speaking of which, yes, do use fire against zombies. 

Also, post (link) your Weekly Challenge 3 Winning screenshots in the comments below. The first players to post their Single Player / Coop screens win extra Action Squad keys, and eternal fame.

Your devs @ KHG and PixelShard

P.S. Just in case anyone's wondering, Door Kickers 2 is still in production.

notes.title: Update: Weekly Challenge #1
notes.content:

notes.title: January patch delayed
notes.content:
We're sorry to report the delay of the January patch.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/3ccc56056112c6aced08e087fcdce2c8b4703b79.jpg[/img]

There were parts of the code that needed to be rewritten and reorganized to  account for the additions and changes to the breacher code - shotgun functionality, including the often requested slug shot change. 

This has proven trickier than expected but will allow us some cool tricks and also make adding more weapons - by devs or modders - much easier in the future. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/7db1d76614796c237229261e8ae42bc0d18a630a.jpg[/img]

But this also means the changes are too deep to launch a partial update - we discussed getting just the new levels and achievements out for now. Not possible, its all or nothing now.

We're working as fast as possible to get the version ready for release.

Thank you for your patience,

Your devs @ KHG & PixelShard

notes.title: Update 0.5.17
notes.content:
Many bug-fixes and quality-of-life improvements. Content update coming in december!


Changelist:
------------------------
+ visual/gameplay improvements on several maps
+ Alt + F1 during gameplay brings up keyboard layout
+ ingame Help mode (F1) shows the Special Ability key when Strategic Bar is full
+ added Exit button on COOP WIN Screen
+ added Next Mission button on COOP LOSE Screen
+ restart now takes you to class selection screen
+ bomber doesn't explode anymore when kicked
+ you can't use special ability in midair or on ladders anymore
+ shows frame latency on multiplayer and FPS when pressing F5
+ barrels incendiated by players that kill enemies count the enemies as kills
+ removed stun from barrel napalm particles
+ strategic bar blinks when getting strategic points
+ respawn buddy icon blinks when playing a 2 player game
+ sniper Support doesn't give SP anymore
+ sniper Support doesn't kill enemies under fog of war
+ you can now jump for a few frames after falling off a platform (you can jump after breaking the horizontal glass too)
+ fixed super powerful air kick effect when kicking an enemy to death near an edge and sending him flying
+ removed aiming error on aimed shot
+ fixed Leader Lemmy "GET HIM" loop
+ COOP: fixed rare lock bug on mission end
+ tuned M4 Carbine a bit different. Its' damage is dependent on range now, to reflect fragmentation
